title: [GLM-4.5V] [vLLM Video inference] <|video|> token doesn't exist in the inputs after data processing
bodyExcerpt:
### Reminder

- [x] I have read the above rules and searched the existing issues.

### System Info


- `llamafactory` version: 0.9.4.dev0
- Platform: Linux-6.4.3-0_fbk15_hardened_2630_gf27365f948db-x86_64-with-glibc2.34
- Python version: 3.12.11
- PyTorch version: 2.7.1+cu128 (GPU)
- Transformers version: 4.56.0.dev0
- Datasets version: 3.6.0
- Accelerate version: 1.7.0
- PEFT version: 0.15.2
- TRL version: 0.9.6
- GPU type: NVIDIA PG509-210
- GPU number: 8
- GPU memory: 79.14GB
- vLLM version: 0.10.1.1
- Default data directory: detected

### Reproduction

I first added video metadata to the video outputs for GLM-4.5V, as GLM4.5V requires it.
```
        elif batch["videos"][j] is not None:
            video = batch["videos"][j]
            multi_modal_data = {
                "video": template_obj.mm_plugin._regularize_videos(
                    video,
                    image_max_pixels=image_max_pixels,
                    image_min_pixels=image_min_pixels,
                    video_fps=video_fps,
                    video_maxlen=video_maxlen,
                )["videos"]
            }
            if "GLM-4.5V" in model_args.model_name_or_path:
                video_data = multi_modal_data["video"]
                for k, each in enumerate(video_data):
                    video_metadata = {
                        "fps": video_fps,
                        "total_num_frames": len(each),
                        "duration": len(each) / video_fps,
                        "video_backend": "opencv"
                    }
                    video_data[k] = (each, video_metadata)
                multi_modal_data["video"] = video_data
```


Then I ran the following command to do inference.
```
DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1 python scripts/vllm_infer.py \
--model_name_or_path=zai-org/GLM-4.5V \
--dataset=mllm_video_demo \
--save_name=/tmp/generations_glm_4.5v.jsonl \
--cutoff_len=8192 \
--max_new_tokens=1024 \
--top_p=0.9 \
--temperature=0.1 \
--template=glm4v_moe \
```
